meta.name: baoyu-post-to-x
meta.description: 自媒体创作者需要在X(Twitter)发布内容时，支持图文、视频、引用推文及Markdown长文发布，通过真实Chrome浏览器绕过反自动化检测，一键完成多格式内容分发，有效规避封号风险。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键把图文视频和长文发布到X，规避封号风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常把图文视频同步到X，担心频繁操作被限流封号。
copy.tagline_en: Publish images, videos and long posts to X in one click, avoiding account bans.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly publish images, videos or long text to X and worry about being flagged or banned.

howto.what: 它能用真实 Chrome 浏览器代你把内容发布到 X(Twitter):文字配图、视频、引用推文,以及 Markdown 长文。默认只做预览,加 --submit 才真正发出。
howto.when: 当你要求把内容发到 X(Twitter),或需要发布图文、视频、引用推文等形式的推文时,它会接管。首次使用需先手动登录一次。

say.text: 把这段内容发到 X:「今天发布了新功能」
say.note: 默认只预览,确认后加 --submit 才发出

say.text: 用 article.md 发一篇 X 长文,封面用 cover.jpg
say.note: 长文发布需要 X Premium 账号

howto.what_en: It posts to X (Twitter) through a real Chrome browser: text with images, video, quote tweets, and long-form Markdown articles. Default is preview; add --submit to actually post.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want content posted to X, including posts with images, video, quote tweets, or Markdown articles. First run needs a manual login.

say_en.text: Post this to X: 'We just shipped a new feature.'
say_en.note: Previews by default; add --submit to publish

say_en.text: Publish article.md as an X Article with cover.jpg as the cover.
Quote https://x.com/user/status/123 with the comment 'Well said.'
